messages.subject: Categorical multilevel workaround
parts:
Hi there,

I wanted to compare the posttest scores of two intervention groups multilevel (because of class differences), including the pretest scores as covariate. Since categorical multilevel is unfortunately not yet supported by lavaan (when does it come...?), I thought, I could maybe just convert the two groups into 0 and 1 and treat this variable as continuos. Could those results be valid or is it total nonsense?

Thanks for your thoughts, Martin

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Categorical multilevel workaround
parts:
Please provide a more thorough description of your variables and model.  It is not clear whether you are confusing multigroup with multilevel modeling, or would like to do both simultaneously (which is possible if it is a cluster-randomized trial), nor which endogenous variables you consider to be ordered=
